column4: What is the HTML a element for?
column8: The a element creates a hyperlink.

column4: What does the fieldset element do?
column8: A fieldset groups related controls.

column4: What does the defer attribute do on a script?
column8: A defer script runs after the document is parsed.

column4: What is a description list dl used for?
column8: A dl groups terms with their descriptions.

column4: What does the sandbox attribute on an iframe do?
column8: The sandbox attribute applies extra restrictions to the embedded document.

column4: How do I make a clickable connection that takes readers to another web page?
column8: The a element with an href attribute creates a hyperlink.

column4: Which tag shows numbered steps where sequence matters?
column8: Use ol when the order of the items matters.

column4: How can I stop the page content from jumping around while pictures are still downloading?
column8: Width and height attributes let browsers reserve space before the image arrives.

column4: How do I let visitors write me a message through their mail application?
column8: A mailto URL opens the visitor email program.

column4: How do I embed an image with img and give it a caption with figure and figcaption?
column8: The img element embeds a picture.|The caption goes inside figcaption within a figure.

column4: How do I link to the contact section of another page and open it in a new tab?
column8: Give the target an id and put a hash sign and the id at the end of the URL.|Setting target _blank opens the link in a new tab.

column4: Which element holds the main content of a page and how should the h1 to h6 headings below its main heading descend?
column8: The main element holds the content unique to the page.|Headings descend one level at a time.

column4: In the label example, what id does the input have?
column8: The input id is email.

column4: What file name does the external script example load?
column8: The example loads app.js.

column4: What are the two steps listed in the ordered list example?
column8: Preheat the oven.|Mix the dough.

column4: Which attribute on a form button changes the HTTP method?
column8: The formmethod attribute of the submit button sets the method.

column4: How does the type attribute change the markers of an ordered list?
column8: The type attribute switches the marker style.

column4: Is a div the right element to embed another HTML document inside the page?
column8: A div only groups elements of the current document.|An iframe embeds a separate HTML document.

column4: Since h1 to h6 only set font sizes, which heading should I use for big text?
column8: The heading number is its rank, not a font size.|Change the visual size with CSS.

column4: Which HTML attribute makes a page load twice as fast on every browser?
column8: No HTML attribute makes a page load twice as fast in every browser.

column4: Can I leave out the alt attribute when an image has a caption?
column8: A caption is never an automatic replacement for alternative text.

column4: Do browsers describe an image from its file name when alt is missing?
column8: Browsers do not generate alternative text from the file name.
